acceptance.given: Repair evidence may already exist in the repository evidence store.

oracle.expected: A new evidence record is appended after prior records, with all prior repair evidence retained byte-for-byte.
forbidden: Any overwrite, deletion, or rewrite of historical repair evidence.
oracle.observable: Validator inspection shows historical records unchanged and a new record strictly appended.

acceptance.then: Existing repair evidence is retained and any new repair evidence is appended.
acceptance.when: During validator evaluation of repair-evidence recording, inspect the persisted evidence sequence and write operation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select repair evidence containing historical records and detect overwrite, deletion, or non-appending writes.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Record repair evidence using append-only writes while preserving historical records.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Existing evidence records and format remain readable; rollback restores prior append-only behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Historical evidence remains unchanged and a new repair record is added at the end.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validator confirms byte-preserved historical records followed by the newly appended record.

acceptance.given: Validator evaluation includes the support-policy requirement and source contract.

oracle.expected: Independent support-policy verification evidence is produced and directly references the support-policy check.
forbidden: Support policy verification is omitted or inferred solely from another verification.
oracle.observable: Validator output contains a distinct support-policy verification result and evidence reference.

acceptance.when: During validator evaluation, execute the support-policy check separately and inspect its evidence.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a validator run where support-policy checking is omitted or only inferred from another check; assert independent-evidence validation fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add an explicit support-policy verification path with independent evidence output.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Support-policy result schema remains backward compatible.

slice_hint.state_transition: Support policy moves to independently verified with attributable evidence.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validator results contain a distinct support-policy assertion and evidence record.

acceptance.given: The Consumer Manifest contains non-empty entries with defined applicable route transitions.

oracle.expected: Every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry completes 100% of its applicable route transitions.
forbidden: Any non-empty entry fails to complete an applicable transition.
Any applicable route transition is omitted.
oracle.observable: Manifest evaluation records show each non-empty entry mapped to and completing every applicable transition.

acceptance.then: Each non-empty Consumer Manifest entry has completed every applicable route transition.
acceptance.when: When applicable route transitions are executed, evaluate completion coverage for all non-empty entries.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a non-empty Consumer Manifest entry with an omitted or failed applicable transition and verify the 100% completion assertion fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Execute and verify every applicable route transition for each non-empty Consumer Manifest entry.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Manifest and route result formats remain compatible.

slice_hint.state_transition: Manifest entries transition from pending to all-applicable-routes-complete with attributable results.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Coverage evaluator reports 100% completion for every non-empty entry with no omitted transitions.

acceptance.given: Matrix Case execution is configured with immutable Stable and Candidate subjects.

oracle.expected: Execution evidence identifies distinct fixtures and distinct execution state for Stable versus Candidate subjects.
forbidden: Stable and Candidate subjects share fixtures.
Stable and Candidate subjects share execution state.
oracle.observable: Per-subject execution records contain different fixture identities and state namespaces.

acceptance.then: Stable and Candidate executions use distinct fixtures and state.
acceptance.when: When Matrix Cases are executed, inspect subject bindings and evidence for fixture/state separation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a Matrix Case whose Stable and Candidate bindings reference the same fixture or state namespace; assert distinctness validation fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Bind Stable and Candidate subjects to separate fixtures and isolated execution state with attributable evidence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Subject and fixture identity fields remain compatible.

slice_hint.state_transition: Stable and Candidate bindings become immutable, distinct fixture/state pairs per Matrix Case.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Matrix Case evidence proves non-equal fixture identities and state namespaces for both subjects.
